audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer invents an ability called 'E Mist Cage' and treats it as the thing that traps you. It appears in wants.you[1], wants.foe[0], content.early twice, whys[2] and whys[6]. There is no such ability.
audit.why: Yorick's E is Mourning Mist — a 700-range thrown globule that marks, slows and shreds armour and drives his summons onto the marked target. The cage is W, Dark Procession, a 600-range destructible wall. The entry's advice to 'side-step the Mist Cage' is right for E and useless for W, and a reader who thinks the cage is a dodgeable skillshot will walk into the wall every time. The full layer already tracks Dark Procession correctly, so the two layers currently contradict each other.
audit.corrected: E is Mourning Mist (projectile, sidestep it). W is Dark Procession, the destructible wall that traps you for the ghouls.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer says the cage can be broken.
audit.why: Riot's own text calls Dark Procession 'a destructible wall'. A Teemo caught inside is not simply dead — attacking one segment opens it, and Toxic Shot's on-hit poison is applied by every auto he spends on the wall anyway. That is the difference between losing the fight and losing 30% HP.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession is destructible — shoot a segment out rather than running the perimeter.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Last Rite' is written for Yorick's Q in wants.you[0] and whys[0].
audit.why: The ability is Last Rites. It is also an auto-attack reset that heals him, which the missing-interactions file flags for this matchup and which neither layer states.
audit.corrected: Last Rites — an auto reset that heals, so the wind-up is the tell and Grievous Wounds is the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Neither layer carried a single number.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s, Mourning Mist is 12s to 8s, Last Rites is 6s to 4s, Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100. Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so you get roughly three darts per rank-1 cage — that is the actual permission structure of the lane.
audit.corrected: Wait for Dark Procession (20s at rank 1) before you step inside 600 units; three of your darts fit inside one of his cages.

edits.after: A single Blinding Dart already erases Yorick's entire trading pattern — his last-hits, his poke autos and the Last Rites reset all miss, so you set the tone.

edits.before: Yorick has zero gap-close — his entire trading pattern is walk up, swing, and Last Rite — so your Blinding Shot shuts him out completely the moment he steps into auto range. Greet him at level 1 with a Q as he reaches for a last-hit, then pepper him with Toxic Shot autos from outside Mist Cage range and retreat before his ghouls can stack. The key threat here is his E: if you let him land the cage while ghouls are alive, he can walk through your blind window and sustain through the poison tick, so always side-step the Mist Cage and never let him initiate the trade rather than you.
edits.after: Yorick has zero gap-close — his pattern is walk up, swing, Last Rites — so your Blinding Dart shuts him out the moment he steps into auto range. Greet him at level 1 with a Q as he reaches for a last-hit, then pepper him with Toxic Shot autos from outside 700 units and retreat before his ghouls stack. Know which ability is which: E is Mourning Mist, a projectile you sidestep, and W is Dark Procession, the destructible wall that actually traps you at 600 range on a 20-second rank-1 cooldown. Never let him open the trade, and if the wall does land, shoot one segment out instead of running its perimeter while the ghouls chew on you.

edits.before: With Q now max-ranked the blind lasts long enough that Yorick cannot realistically trade back even with empowered Last Rites, and your mushrooms in the tribush and river choke mean he cannot recall or roam without taking free damage. The Maiden appears around this window — immediately drop mushrooms on the lane-entry brushes and the path between lane and inner tower so she triggers them before she can shove a plate. Keep poking Yorick himself off the wave; if he zones you to free-farm he is banking on out-scaling, which he will, so deny him cannon minions and deny the Maiden her plate pressure simultaneously.
edits.after: With Q now max-ranked the blind lasts long enough that Yorick cannot realistically trade back even with an empowered Last Rites, and your mushrooms in the tribush and river choke mean he cannot recall or roam without taking free damage. Your dart is a flat 7 seconds against his 20-second rank-1 Dark Procession, so count it: three darts fit inside one cage cooldown, and that is the window you step up in. The Maiden appears around here — drop mushrooms on the lane-entry brushes and the path to your inner tower so she triggers them before she can shove a plate. Keep poking Yorick himself off the wave and deny him cannons.

notes: The content layer invented an ability called 'E Mist Cage' and used it six times; Yorick's E is Mourning Mist and the cage is W, Dark Procession. The full layer already had this right, so the two layers were contradicting each other on the matchup's single most important cooldown. Separate data-quality issue not proposed as an edit: content.spikes[2].text and content.whys[5] both spell the item 'Liandry's Angueur', which is not a real item name in any patch, while the full layer for this same matchup calls it 'Liandry's Torment'. I could not verify which name is live on 26.15 from the kit files, so I left both strings alone rather than guess.
